newsitem.title: UK: NatWest data show Xmas spending spree in UK.
newsitem.headline: NatWest data show Xmas spending spree in UK.

text.p: National Westminster Bank said on Friday the amount of spending indicated by figures for its credit and debit cards and cashpoint machines confirmed predictions of a Christmas spending spree in Britain.
NatWest said the highest single day of spending through its cards and machines came on Monday, December 23, when withdrawals totalled 72.5 million stg, up nearly a third on last year's record.
Monday also saw the highest number of authorisations ever seen by NatWest on a single day, the bank said -- 2.7 million credit and debit card payments, or about 80 each second.

An average of over 27.0 million stg was withdrawn in each Sunday in December in the run-up to Christmas, suggesting Sunday shopping is becoming more popular. Last year, Sunday withdrawals in December averaged 16.5 million, NatWest said.
More than five million stg was withdrawn from NatWest cards and machines on Christmas Day alone, double the figure from Christmas Day last year.
